title: MRR QuestionModel
description: docs/spec/08_RESEARCH_METHOD_KERNEL.md (status ACCEPTED, 2026-07-21) section 3's object table ('QuestionModel | decomposition of a question: claim type sought, population/scope/time, load-bearing terms flagged for operationalization | draft -> accepted -> superseded'). First of the six task-packets/K1-T01.yaml entities. MRR-MTH-001: a question addressed through the runtime MUST be represented as an accepted QuestionModel before an executor task for it is negotiated; a raw natural-language question MUST NOT directly create an executable analysis task. This schema makes a QuestionModel a first-class, independently reviewable object with its own lifecycle, distinct from and prior to any TaskBundle — it does not itself enforce that a TaskBundle references one (service-level, deferred to task-packets/K1-T02.yaml). 'claim_type_sought' reuses claim.schema.json's own 'claim_type' enum verbatim (singular — the one claim type this question seeks, versus MethodProfile.claim_types' plural set a profile CAN produce). 'scope' reuses common.schema.json#/$defs/scope verbatim for 'population/scope/time' rather than inventing a parallel shape. 'load_bearing_terms' is required present but NOT required non-empty, mirroring MethodProfile.inappropriate_uses' identical judgment call (task-packets/K0-T01.yaml specification_gaps).

raw_question.description: The original natural-language question this object decomposes (MRR-MTH-001). Never itself an executable task.

claim_type_sought.description: The single claim type this question seeks, drawn verbatim from schemas/claim.schema.json's own 'claim_type' enum (mrr.contracts.claim.ClaimType) — no parallel vocabulary invented.

load_bearing_terms.description: Terms flagged for operationalization via a ConceptCharter entry (MRR-MTH-002: every load-bearing term of an accepted QuestionModel MUST reference a versioned ConceptCharter operationalization — not itself validated here, service-level). An empty array is schema-valid; spec 08 does not require a non-empty floor (mirrors MethodProfile.inappropriate_uses' identical precedent).

status.description: Lifecycle status (spec 08 section 3's table: draft -> accepted -> superseded).
